$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this file.

targets.description: AI coding tools to generate configuration for. Use '*' to select every supported tool. In object form each key is a target name and each value is a feature list or feature options object — 'features' must then be omitted.

features.description: Features to generate. Valid values: rules, commands, subagents, skills, mcp, hooks, permissions, checks, ignore. Omit when 'targets' is in object form.

outputRoots.description: Directories where generated files are written. Defaults to the project root ('.'). In object form each key is a target name and each value is a path or array of paths.

inputRoot.description: Deprecated. Parent directory of a canonical source tree. Carabiner appends '.carabiner/' to derive the source tree path. Use 'inputRoots' instead.

inputRoots.description: Ordered list of canonical source tree directories. The first root must exist. Later roots are optional overlays and override earlier roots for matching relative paths.

delete.description: Delete orphaned generated files before writing. Files no longer produced by any source are removed.

global.description: Write to user-scope tool configuration paths instead of project-local paths.

simulateCommands.description: Generate a simulated commands section in the root rule for tools that do not support native commands.

simulateSubagents.description: Generate a simulated subagents section in the root rule for tools that do not support native subagents.

simulateSkills.description: Generate a simulated skills section in the root rule for tools that do not support native skills.

dryRun.description: Preview changes without writing any files. Cannot be combined with 'check'.

check.description: Exit with a non-zero code if any file would change. Useful in CI pipelines. Cannot be combined with 'dryRun'.

gitignoreTargetsOnly.description: When running 'carabiner gitignore', add entries only for the tools listed in 'targets'. Set to false to add entries for every supported tool.

gitignoreDestination.description: File that 'carabiner gitignore' appends generated-path entries to.

flattenedCommandNaming.description: Naming convention for commands in flat output formats. 'basename' uses the file stem. 'path' uses the relative path with slashes replaced by hyphens.

sources.description: Declarative rule and skill sources installed via 'carabiner install'.

source.description: Repository or package source. For GitHub transport: 'owner/repo', 'owner/repo@ref', or 'owner/repo@ref:path'. For git transport: a full git URL. For npm transport: a package name.

skills.description: Skill names to install. Use ['*'] to install all skills.

rules.description: Rule file names to install. Use ['*'] to install all rules.

transport.description: Fetch transport. 'github' uses the GitHub REST API. 'git' works with any git remote. 'npm' fetches from an npm-compatible registry.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to fetch. Defaults to the remote default branch. For npm transport: an exact version or dist-tag.

path.description: Path to the skills directory within the repository. Defaults to 'skills'.

rulesPath.description: Path to the rules directory within the repository. Defaults to 'rules'.

registry.description: npm transport only. Base URL of the npm-compatible registry. Defaults to https://registry.npmjs.org.

tokenEnv.description: npm transport only. Environment variable holding the registry authentication token.

agent.description: gh mode only. Target agent for skill installation.
